items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, escalating privileges and potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability specific to Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: This incorrect authorization flaw allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized write access to Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store, potentially leading to remote code execution or account takeover.
